task.title: Check a version against a semver range
task.statement:
Write a JavaScript function `semverSatisfies(version, range)` that returns `true` if `version` satisfies `range`, `false` if it does not, and `null` if either argument is invalid.

Versions (Semantic Versioning 2.0.0, without build metadata):
- `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`, each a non-negative integer without leading zeros (`0` itself is fine).
- Optional pre-release: `-` followed by dot-separated identifiers made of `[0-9A-Za-z-]`. Identifiers are non-empty; numeric identifiers have no leading zeros.
- Precedence follows SemVer 2.0.0: compare major, minor, patch numerically; a version with a pre-release is lower than the same version without one; pre-release identifiers are compared left to right, numeric ones numerically, alphanumeric ones in ASCII order, numeric lower than alphanumeric, and a shorter list is lower if all preceding identifiers are equal.

Ranges:
- A range is one or more comparator sets separated by `||`. A version satisfies the range if it satisfies any set.
- A set is one or more comparators separated by whitespace. A version satisfies the set if it satisfies every comparator in it.
- A comparator is an operator immediately followed by a full version: `=`, `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `^`, `~`, or no operator (same as `=`).
- `^M.m.p` means `>=M.m.p <(M+1).0.0` when M > 0; `>=0.m.p <0.(m+1).0` when M = 0 and m > 0; `>=0.0.p <0.0.(p+1)` when M = m = 0. Any pre-release on the caret version stays on the lower bound.
- `~M.m.p` means `>=M.m.p <M.(m+1).0` (pre-release stays on the lower bound).
- Whitespace around `||` and at both ends is ignored. Empty sets are invalid. Wildcards, `x`, hyphen ranges and partial versions are not supported and make the range invalid.

Pre-release rule: a version that has a pre-release satisfies a set only if, in addition, at least one comparator of that set (after expanding `^` and `~`, looking at its lower bound) has a pre-release and the same MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH as the version.
